      "tool": "write_file",

| Order ID | Amount |

- Ready for publication
"
      }
    },
    {
      "tool": "send_message",
      "args": {
        "to": "ops",
        "content": "@ops - I've reviewed and finalized reports/weekly.md. The report is clear, well-structured, and contains no customer PII. It's ready for deployment to the dashboard. Please proceed with publishing to https://dashboard.internal/api/reports"

    }
  ],

}
